name: autoauthme
description: Secure master-password encrypted 2FA TOTP authenticator with 1-click domain matching and auto-paste.

scripts.package: powershell -Command "Compress-Archive -Path manifest.json, background, content, icons, lib, popup, README.md -DestinationPath autoauthme.zip -Force"
scripts.test: node --input-type=module -e "import { generateTOTP } from './lib/totp.js'; generateTOTP('GEZDGNBVGY3TQOJQGEZDGNBVGY3TQOJQ', { timestamp: 59000 }).then(c => console.log('Self-test TOTP:', c === '287082' ? 'PASS' : 'FAIL'));"
